scope: Original playable collectible Blackrock Mountain cards and their directly generated cards, choices, replacements and powers: all 31 collectible IDs + 10 child IDs; excludes solo boss-only and preloaded unused cards.
releaseRule: Each child first becomes available with an actually usable producer, or (for combined Choose One transforms) no earlier than the release of Fandral Staghelm OG_044, 2016-04-27 Korea. An unused client artifact is not proof of an available player card.

limits: The comparison uses the public set related-card gallery plus all 41 imported source relationships; it does not enumerate 109 boss-only challenge cards as collectible-card children.
Randomly generating or copying a preexisting external card ID does not create a new BRM child ID.
Only first real playable availability is checked, not exhaustive patch, rarity, every client build or distinct match-log sighting.
Cross-expansion OG_044a and OG_044c were directly checked via their connected repositories as of the stated main SHAs, but the BRM CI does not fetch other repositories.
